body.title: Implement enumerateManagers
body.summary: enumerateManagers(repoPath, targets) walks repoPath to find every manager's manifest/lockfile, returning each detected manager with its manifestDir, and flags an unresolved ambiguity when two manifests for the same manager family appear in one directory.
acceptanceChecks: enumerateManagers finds a manager for each of the 8 supported manifest/lockfile shapes (npm/pnpm/yarn/pip/pipenv/poetry/go/cargo)
two manifests for the same manager family in one directory are recorded as an unresolved ambiguity, never silently resolved to one
a directory with no recognizable manifest yields no manager for that directory

tests.name: enumerateManagers finds a manager for each of the 8 supported manifest/lockfile shapes
